featuredProjects.title: Smart Thermostat Security Audit
featuredProjects.description: End-to-end security assessment across hardware interfaces, mobile app flows, and cloud components of a real IoT ecosystem. Uncovered 3+ critical vulnerabilities (backend RCE, plaintext credential storage, hardcoded API keys) and produced a remediation-prioritized report with PoC reproduction steps.

featuredProjects.title: GeoAlarm - iOS Location Alarm App
featuredProjects.description: Shipped a native iOS app to the App Store with 100% on-device computation and zero cloud dependencies — privacy-by-design, no tracking SDKs. Reduced battery consumption ~80% via CoreLocation geofencing; implemented AVAudioSession override to guarantee delivery regardless of hardware silent switch state.

featuredProjects.title: Metadata Analyzer & Threat Correlator
featuredProjects.description: Built a Python tool to extract, sanitize, and analyze file metadata across 5+ formats, cutting manual review time ~70%. Designed correlation logic to automatically flag anomalous patterns associated with document tampering, leaks, or risky provenance.

featuredProjects.title: University Wargame Environment
featuredProjects.tech: Red & Blue Team · Active Directory · Wazuh SIEM · DMZ
featuredProjects.description: Conducted offensive and defensive operations on real machines across isolated network segments with DMZ architecture, attacking and hardening both Linux and Windows hosts. Executed AD attack chains (enumeration, lateral movement, and privilege escalation) and deployed/operated Wazuh SIEM for log correlation and threat detection.

featuredProjects.title: CTF Writeups
